purpose: Point-in-time replay of past sessions as if live; decisions see only information timestamped before T; scored afterwards; never mixed with live records.

models.note: pinned ids; the CLI-reported model identity is stored with every call

probe.source: Alpaca news archive (Benzinga), one dated headline per event, question written without the answer
probe.context: none, no tools, one event per call
probe.scoring: correct = knows=true AND every answer-key group matched (regex, case-insensitive)
probe.floor_rule: a month is KNOWN for a model when >= 2 of its 6 events are answered correctly; the model's replay floor is the first day of the month after its last KNOWN month (first probe month when none is known); a variant starts at max(period start, floor of every model it calls)

periods.test_rule: run once with a configuration hashed and committed before the run; no tuning on test

decision_time_utc: 12:00:00 on every NYSE session day (08:00 New York, the live am run time); all period days are EDT

information_snapshot.rule: every item carries available_at <= T and is rejected otherwise; the snapshot is canonical-hashed and the hash is stored with the decision
information_snapshot.news: Alpaca /v1beta1/news, created_at < T AND updated_at < T (revised items are excluded, never shown in their later form)
information_snapshot.daily_bars: Alpaca /v2/stocks/bars 1Day raw, sessions whose close <= T only; crypto /v1beta3/crypto/us/bars 1Day bars whose day ended <= T
information_snapshot.sec: data.sec.gov submissions, 8-K filings with acceptanceDateTime < T only; CIK map is today's company_tickers.json (limitation)

a_v1_as_live.prompt: trader_agent.runners.prompt() unchanged, with replay_preamble.txt prepended; output validated by trader_agent.schemas validate_analyst / validate_reviewer plus citation-in-snapshot check; one retry on invalid output (as live)
a_v1_as_live.universe: live grant universe: 25 stocks + XLK XLF XLE XLI XLV + SOL AVAX LINK DOGE LTC (BTC/ETH not in the live universe and protected 2026-09-01..2026-11-30); SPY and QQQ as unpredicted benchmarks
a_v1_as_live.context: per asset: 21 completed daily closes, 1/5/20 returns, vol_20d (trader_agent.data.price_summary); per asset up to 8 Alpaca headlines from the last 72 h; macro headlines tagged SPY/QQQ up to 15

c_news_small_mid.candidates: symbols of Alpaca news created in [previous session close, T), items naming at most 2 symbols; US equities with price >= 5 USD and 20-session median dollar volume in (10M, 1B] USD (small/mid proxy: no market-cap source in scope); live-universe names, ETFs and benchmarks excluded; at most 40 candidates ranked by negative-keyword score then recency; at most 3 headlines each
c_news_small_mid.entry: open of the decision session (next open after T)

d_news_primary_only.filter: keep a view only if its symbol has an SEC 8-K accepted in [T-72h, T) (earnings releases are 8-K item 2.02)

robustness_anonymized.variant: a_v1_as_live analyst only (b) on every 4th dev decision day
robustness_anonymized.method: tickers and company names replaced by stable per-day codes, URLs replaced by opaque ids, price levels rescaled by a per-asset random factor (returns unchanged); compared with the named run on the same days
robustness_anonymized.reference: Glasserman & Lin, Assessing look-ahead bias in stock return predictions generated by GPT sentiment analysis (2023)

fills.a_b_1d: entry = VWAP of the 13:30Z one-minute bar (open + ~30 s); exit = open of the 19:55Z one-minute bar (close - 5 min); SPY the same
fills.a_b_5d: entry = session open (daily bar), exit = close of session 5
fills.crypto_1d: entry = VWAP of the 13:30Z one-minute bar, exit = VWAP of the 13:30Z bar next day; absolute direction (no benchmark)
fills.c_d: entry = daily open of the decision session, exit = daily close of session h

costs.applied_to: the traded asset leg; the SPY-relative return measures the view, the hedge leg is not charged (stated limitation)

labels.hit: UP and net SPY-relative return > 0, or DOWN and < 0 (crypto: absolute)
labels.brier: (p_outperform - 1[outperform])^2 on directional views; abstentions excluded and counted

metrics: hit rate with counts and Wilson 95% CI
daily P&L Sharpe (equal-weight views, booked on the decision day, all session days incl. zero days, x sqrt 252)
max drawdown of cumulative daily P&L
effective sample size: distinct (day, cluster, direction) groups and ICC design effect

baselines.spy: long SPY over the same entry/exit

protected: BTC-USD and ETH-USD 2026-09-01..2026-11-30 never requested, never in a snapshot or label
trial_registry: docs/artifacts/replay_bench_trials_v1.json lists every run (variant, period, config hash, counts); nothing is deleted
storage: private store outside Git with provenance REPLAY_POST_CUTOFF; Git holds code, spec, freeze and registry hashes and counts only
